text: With all my power, I shall shine one last guiding light upon you.
zh: 我将倾尽全力，为你点亮最后一束指引之光。

text:
I can feel that you are still in pain.
Inside the crypt of your ancestors, your soul is unable to find peace.
zh:
我能感觉到，你仍在痛苦之中。
在你先祖的墓穴里，你的灵魂无法得到安宁。

text: I wish someone were able to release your tortured spirit.
zh: 但愿有人能解脱你饱受折磨的魂灵。

text: With all my power, I shall shine one last guiding light upon you.
zh: 我将倾尽全力，为你点亮最后一束指引之光。

text:
Oh, my dear king!
Your spirit is finally free.
zh:
哦，我亲爱的王！
你的灵魂终于自由了。

text:
Now go to sleep.
You deserve it.
zh:
安睡吧。
这是你应得的。
